_readme: System-derived, curated aliases only - never official ZHO data, never written into catalog.json's word_en/word_ar fields. Empty at prototype creation because no linguistically safe alias curation has been done yet by a sign-language expert; layer 3 of lib/vocab_retrieval.py reads this file and is a no-op until entries are added. Each entry must point at a real catalog_id (see data/zho/catalog.json) and should only ever be added deterministically (a human-reviewed synonym), not auto-generated by an LLM without review, per the brief's explicit instruction that LLM-suggested aliases must not automatically become trusted.

schema.catalog_id: stable ZHO catalog id this alias set applies to
aliases_en: safe, human-reviewed English synonyms/forms not already covered by morphology
